CUDA provider activation does not assert every node is assigned to GPU.

No human subjects or attack dataset; no AUC/APCER/BPCER or threshold validation.
Network-only timings include device transfers, exclude detection/capture/preprocessing.
Laptop RAM/load were not isolated; CPU GenD timing varied greatly between two runs. Do not treat speedup as a deployment guarantee.
FS-VFM CUDA does not match the default fused PyTorch CUDA reference at the fixed tolerance; no accepted speed comparison for that pair. Its ONNX CUDA outputs match the original CPU reference.
GPU memory numbers are whole-device snapshots, not per-model peak VRAM.
FP32 ONNX weights are not smaller than their source checkpoints.
